mapper.select: SELECT cr.*, ct.label AS course_label, et.label AS environment_label FROM class_record cr JOIN course_type ct ON ct.code = cr.course_code JOIN environment_type et ON et.code = cr.environment_code WHERE cr.student_id = #{studentId} AND cr.record_date = #{recordDate} ORDER BY cr.id

SELECT cr.*, ct.label AS course_label, et.label AS environment_label FROM class_record cr JOIN course_type ct ON ct.code = cr.course_code JOIN environment_type et ON et.code = cr.environment_code WHERE cr.id = #{id} AND cr.student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO class_record (student_id, creator_id, record_date, course_code, course_other_description, environment_code, environment_other_description, observation_duration_minutes, overall_remark) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{creatorId}, #{recordDate}, #{courseCode}, #{courseOtherDescription}, #{environmentCode}, #{environmentOtherDescription}, #{observationDurationMinutes}, #{overallRemark})
mapper.update: UPDATE class_record SET record_date = #{recordDate}, course_code = #{courseCode}, course_other_description = #{courseOtherDescription}, environment_code = #{environmentCode}, environment_other_description = #{environmentOtherDescription}, observation_duration_minutes = #{observationDurationMinutes}, overall_remark = #{overallRemark} WHERE id = #{id} AND student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM course_type WHERE code = #{code}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM environment_type WHERE code = #{code}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM behavior_type WHERE code = #{code}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM behavior_stage_type WHERE code = #{code}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM behavior_function_type WHERE code = #{code}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM assistance_type WHERE code = #{code}
SELECT bt.code, bt.label FROM course_behavior_config config JOIN behavior_type bt ON bt.code = config.behavior_code WHERE config.course_code = #{courseCode} ORDER BY bt.code

SELECT bt.code AS behavior_code, bt.label AS behavior_label, COUNT(br.id) AS count, latest.id AS latest_record_id, latest.detail_saved AS latest_detail_saved FROM ( SELECT behavior_code FROM course_behavior_config WHERE course_code = #{courseCode} UNION SELECT behavior_code FROM behavior_record WHERE class_record_id = #{classRecordId} ) relevant JOIN behavior_type bt ON bt.code = relevant.behavior_code LEFT JOIN behavior_record br ON br.class_record_id = #{classRecordId} AND br.behavior_code = relevant.behavior_code LEFT JOIN behavior_record latest ON latest.id = ( SELECT newest.id FROM behavior_record newest WHERE newest.class_record_id = #{classRecordId} AND newest.behavior_code = relevant.behavior_code ORDER BY newest.occurred_at DESC, newest.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) GROUP BY bt.code, bt.label, latest.id, latest.detail_saved ORDER BY bt.code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO behavior_record (class_record_id, creator_id, occurred_at, behavior_code) VALUES (#{classRecordId}, #{creatorId}, #{occurredAt}, #{behaviorCode})
mapper.select: SELECT br.id, br.class_record_id, br.creator_id, br.occurred_at, br.behavior_code, bt.label AS behavior_label, br.detail_saved FROM behavior_record br JOIN behavior_type bt ON bt.code = br.behavior_code WHERE br.class_record_id = #{classRecordId} AND br.behavior_code = #{behaviorCode} ORDER BY br.occurred_at, br.id

SELECT br.*, bt.label AS behavior_label, stage_type.label AS stage_label, function_type.label AS function_label FROM behavior_record br JOIN class_record cr ON cr.id = br.class_record_id JOIN behavior_type bt ON bt.code = br.behavior_code LEFT JOIN behavior_stage_type stage_type ON stage_type.code = br.stage_code LEFT JOIN behavior_function_type function_type ON function_type.code = br.function_code WHERE br.id = #{id} AND cr.student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.delete: DELETE br FROM behavior_record br JOIN class_record cr ON cr.id = br.class_record_id WHERE br.id = #{id} AND cr.student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE behavior_record SET duration_minutes = #{durationMinutes}, stage_code = #{stageCode}, antecedent_text = #{antecedentText}, behavior_description = #{behaviorDescription}, consequence_text = #{consequenceText}, function_code = #{functionCode}, assistance_result_text = #{assistanceResultText}, detail_saved = TRUE WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO behavior_record_assistance (behavior_record_id, assistance_code, content) VALUES (#{recordId}, #{code}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT bra.assistance_code AS code, bra.content, at.label, at.group_code AS `group` FROM behavior_record_assistance bra JOIN assistance_type at ON at.code = bra.assistance_code WHERE bra.behavior_record_id = #{recordId} ORDER BY at.display_order

SELECT bt.code AS behavior_code, bt.label AS behavior_label, COUNT(br.id) AS count FROM behavior_record br JOIN class_record cr ON cr.id = br.class_record_id JOIN behavior_type bt ON bt.code = br.behavior_code WHERE cr.student_id = #{studentId} AND cr.record_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY bt.code, bt.label ORDER BY count DESC, bt.code
